evals.name: attention-ste80
evals.prompt: Explain how a transformer's attention works, 80% of the way to ASD-STE100.
evals.expected_output: Rung 1 STE prose at strictness 80; lint passes at 80; hedges kept; ends with escalation line.

evals.name: diff-explain
evals.prompt: Explain this git diff to me: evals/files/retry.diff
evals.expected_output: Rung 1 by default; every claim traceable to the diff; no invented intent (diff gives no reason).

evals.name: oauth-diagram
evals.prompt: Diagram how the OAuth2 authorization-code flow works.
evals.expected_output: Rung 2: one SVG (or Mermaid) file; labels <=6 words; real sequence of actors and messages.

evals.name: gradient-descent-html
evals.prompt: Make an interactive HTML explainer of gradient descent.
evals.expected_output: Rung 3: single offline-capable HTML file with a learning-rate slider running real GD; visible text lints at 80.

evals.name: fourier-video
evals.prompt: Create a 3b1b style video explainer on the Fourier transform.
evals.expected_output: Rung 4: Manim scene.py + STE narration.md; no ElevenLabs key so local TTS fallback named; missing manim gives install command, not crash; nothing installed.

evals.name: incident-hedge-diagram
evals.prompt: Read evals/files/incident-note.md and make me a diagram of what happened.
evals.expected_output: Rung 2 diagram; the race-condition cause stays hedged (possible/may, dashed), gateway-bug alternative shown; no new facts.
